title: [PS5] Astro Bot $59 ($49 after $10 Newsletter Sign-up Voucher) + $9 Delivery ($0 C&C/ OnePass/ $60 Order) @ Target (Excl. TAS)
body:
Deal: [PS5] Astro Bot $59 ($49 after $10 Newsletter Sign-up Voucher) + $9 Delivery ($0 C&C/ OnePass/ $60 Order) @ Target (Excl. TAS)

[Odin] incredible game, highly recommend if you grew up on playstation
[Nillionaire] I didn't grow up on PlayStation and thought it was incredible too!
[DaveD] I couldn't agree more! The amount of creativity packed into this amazing game is incredible…
[Budju] I have caved in for $49. Best hope you be right
Had to had a 3 pack of underwear for $10 to get the free shipping (over $50), but I needed those anyway.
[solidussnake] I found the free tech demo of Astro more fun including the music etc
[Graffin] The Playroom (PS4) and Astro's Playroom (PS5) were definitely great games (and free).
I still haven't found the time to finish Astro Bot Rescue Mission (the PSVR game), but that's also an incredible game.
As for Astro Bot…. It'll definitely challenge you and some levels will have you swearing and cursing and replaying them (a lot), but it's definitely the best of the series. With each new Astro Bot game, they add more elements and make it even more fun.
I guess the thing that may put off some players is that it's way longer. It's not the kinda game where you can just play a bit in between taking a break from other games. And, the difficulty of some of the challenge levels, or anything that is like a speed run, it tends to put me off too, but it has to be one of the best games i've ever played. I do wish there was a new Sackboy/Little Big Planet game though!
[SmokeyTheCorgi] Great game. A wonderful modernisation of a type of game they rarely make anymore.
[sween64] Bought, played, sold and now bought again. Thanks.
[Nillionaire] That was Astro's Playroom (2020) which came preinstalled for free. This is Astro Bot (2024) which won Game of the Year beating the likes of Black Myth Wukong!
[ozbozb123] Astro's Playroom is a great game in its own right.
Astrobot is the best game.
[savemesomemoney] How are you accessing Target? The past deals including this one, the site had been down.
[ce5himm] Great game, however not so sure about GOTY
[toddles321] Thank you! Been wanting this game for some time! Just got it via JB-Hifi. Did online chat made them price match it to Target. Then i used the $10 perk signup purchased total $49 and local click and collect.
[guidedlight] This game is almost playable via emulation, in a few months it will be perfect.
[JacobAU] The one game I’m considering buying a PlayStation for. Hope it comes to pc one day
[thespensa] Same here, but I don't think so, even more Sony move away from single player games on PC, this game is too ingrained with PlayStation
[justtoreply] I'm the odd one out that thought it was extremely competent, but somehow missing something in the gameplay that truly hooked me in. I'd still give it 7.5/10.
[noob789] Fantastic game, can't recommend it enough. My daughter and I loved it so much we got the platinum.
[Kerrby] Still my favourite PS5 game. I hope we get a sequel soon.
